environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with IAM task role 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/ProfileServiceRole'. The role has a broad DynamoDB policy: Effect=Allow, Action=dynamodb:GetItem/PutItem/UpdateItem, Resource=arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111222333444:table/UserProfiles. No DynamoDB fine-grained access control condition keys are applied. The X-Authenticated-User header is set by an upstream Envoy sidecar from the JWT 'sub' claim after signature verification.

config.auth: Envoy sidecar validates JWT, sets X-Authenticated-User from sub claim
